helmcutter.body:
Notes: - Restriction: Helmcutter wielder
- Condition: natural 6 on a roll To Wound with it
- Result: the enemy model gets no armour save against that attack

the-axe-of-abandon.body:
Notes: - Condition: Extra Attacks (D3) special rule yields a 3
- Result: wielder suffers −1 To Hit
- Duration: to the close of that Combat phase

the-briar-bow.body:
Notes: - Restriction: the Briar-bow
- Condition: its roll To Hit is successful
- Result: hits dealt = 1 Artillery dice (not the usual 1)
  - Misfire instead: 1 hit on the wielder, and after it resolves the weapon shatters for good

the-flaming-sword.body:
Notes: - Restriction: the Flaming Sword wielder; cannot join any unit that has the Regeneration (X+) special rule
- Select: models that have the Flammable special rule
- Result: the roll this weapon needs To Wound them is always 4+, whatever their Toughness

the-armour-of-jet.body:
Notes: - Restriction: the Armour of Jet
- Result: heavy armour; a Wizard wears it with no penalty
  - Drawback: if that Wizard miscasts or is outclassed in the art, −1 on the Miscast table roll

the-banner-of-the-resolute-dead.body:
Notes: - Restriction: the Banner Of The Resolute Dead, held by a unit
- Result:
  - always: Movement characteristic of the bearing unit −1
  - optional, when that unit takes a Leadership test or a Break test: throw 1 further D6 and set aside the highest die

the-mouldering-banner.body:
Notes: - Restriction: the Mouldering Banner
- Result: two penalties
  - Enemy unit picking a unit with the banner as target in the shooting phase: extra −1 To Hit
  - Friendly units ≤6" of the unit carrying the banner: extra −1 To Hit on their shooting attacks

the-obsidian-pendant.body:
Notes: - Restriction: the Obsidian Pendant bearer
- Result: single-purpose protection
  - Magic Missle wounds on the bearer: Ward save 4+
  - However, any failed Ward save of this kind destroys the pendant, to be used no more

the-pariah-stone.body:
Notes: - Restriction: the Pariah Stone bearer
- Timing: any model, friend or foe, wants to pick the bearer as target of a spell or Bound spell
- Result: that model takes a Leadership test with its own Leadership first
  - Failed: it picks another target
  - Passed: the bearer is a legal target

barrow-dirt.body:
Notes: - Restriction: Barrow-dirt
- Limits: 0-1 per model; single use
- Result: breath weapon
  - Special Rules: Breath Weapon, Magical Attacks, Multiple Wounds (2)
  - Profile: R: N/A, S: 3, AP: -3
  - once the breath weapon is resolved: the bearer takes an Initiative test; failing it puts the bearer at risk of a hit as if it stood partly under the flame template

the-crown-of-fury.body:
Notes: - Restriction: the Crown of Fury
- Result: its wearer is granted the special rules Furious Charge and Impetuous; the mount receives neither

crude-canopics.body:
Notes: - Restriction: Crude Canopic bearer
- Timing: bearer makes a Wizardly dispel attempt
- Result: any natural double besides double 1 unbinds the spell
  - Drawback: natural double 1 is a normal defeat in the art, plus 2 rolls on the Miscast table, both applied

morithein-s-magnifier.body:
Notes: - Restriction: Morthein's Magnifier bearer
- Limits: 1× per turn
- Timing: ahead of declaring the spell's target
- Result: (optional) spell's range +3"; its Casting Value rises by 1
